doc.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007

title: Upcoming plans and Les Paul Trio in Cleveland
summary: Monday nights at the Iridium, King University, and an earlier Cleveland show with Gary Mazzaroppi.

venues.name: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Anything in the near future that’s coming up that you’re particularly looking forward to?

Monday nights are always there at the Iridium in New York City. And we just did King University a couple of weeks ago, that was with Les too. I think we’re supposed to open up some more House of Blues or do Cleveland again. We did, actually we did Cleveland before they even had the rock & roll Hall of Fame built. And that was — Ray Charles was there, the Les Paul Trio. Then we just had the trio. Gary Mazzaroppi on bass, myself and Les. And they didn’t even have the building yet. We did the first where they were getting the money for it, to build. And then we went out and did the rock & roll Hall of Fame a couple of times. And it was different groups now, but went out there. And that’s about the only thing. They want us back out there, they want us in Cleveland again for the House of Blues, but of course I don’t think Les wants to travel too much now.
So we’ll stick with New York for now, stay in the New York area.

Yeah. Okay. Well it’s something to keep making a living in music, that’s the way I feel, to have that ability to, as you said, step into one king of gig and then the next night another kind and it also keeps your mind pretty active. © Fillius Jazz Archive -24-
